It was evident that Nerolac had not adequately planned and organized their resources, leaving customers like me to suffer the consequences.

The unprofessionalism and lack of accountability displayed by Nerolac throughout this entire ordeal were appalling. They showed a complete disregard for customer satisfaction and failed to take responsibility for their actions. Instead of finding a solution or offering an alternative, they simply shrugged off their responsibilities, leaving me to deal with the fallout.

I strongly advise others to exercise extreme caution when considering Nerolac Service for their projects. Based on my experience, their promises cannot be trusted, and their contractors are unreliable. It is evident that Nerolac lacks proper management and fails to deliver on their commitments. Save yourself the frustration and disappointment by seeking services elsewhere.

In conclusion, my experience with Nerolac Service was deeply disappointing. Their false promises, sudden denials, and lack of accountability have left me with a bitter taste. I hope this review serves as a warning to others who may be considering their services, and I sincerely hope Nerolac takes steps to address these issues and improve their service quality in the future.
